plan.text: After the diamond lead, play D3 and plan to win in South with DK, keeping DA as a later winner. There are eight top tricks available in the side suits (DA-K, HA-K, SA, CA-K and CQ). Use the club honors to drive out the missing clubs and establish a long club for the ninth trick, preserving a heart entry to dummy where possible. If clubs do not establish safely, look for an extra heart trick; prioritize making 3NT before pursuing overtricks.
